lines.en: Tail swinging through Cretaceous water.

lines.zh: 我这身鳞片在水里最滑
lines.en: My scales are slickest in water.
A Brazilian fossil, now swimming.
My mouth is wide enough for a whole fish.
Waterweed brushes my back.
One tail flick stirs the mud.
I know the cracks in the riverbed.
Cruising slowly; no need to rush.
The Cretaceous river is muddier than now.
I pass, and the fish scatter.
My scales catch the water's light.

lines.zh: 水面上只看得到我的背鳍
lines.en: Only my dorsal fin shows above water.
This gulp of air lasts a long dive.
The school flees ahead of me.
Forty points of flesh, cruising steady.
Ride the current; it saves effort.
My shadow moves through the deep.
Prey hides in the crevices.
Hanging in the water, perfectly still.
My gill covers open and close.
Waiting for fish to swim to me.
The riverbed mud is soft.
Even closed, this mouth is frightening.
Cretaceous water is just the right warmth.
The weed moves, but not from me.
No prey yet; I keep waiting.
My jaws open and the water flows through.
On the bottom I look like a stone block.
The surface light makes my eyes swim.
These waters are mine.
I'll stop chasing; the next school will come.
A soft tail beat holds my place.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我在水里看你
lines.en: You're on land; I watch from the water.
A two-legged one, not much meat.
You've stood at the water's edge too long.
Care to try these jaws?
Your shadow falls on the water.

lines.zh: 我不是鱼，别拿鱼饵逗我
lines.en: I'm no ordinary fish; don't dangle bait.
Underwater, my eyes are the brightest thing.

lines.zh: 你再靠近一步，水就浑了
lines.en: One step closer, and the water will churn.
We size each other up.

lines.zh: 岸上是你的，水里是我的
lines.en: The shore is yours; the water is mine.
My scales have been torn open.
Even underwater, blows hurt.
I thrash my tail and pull away.
Blood spreads through the water.
That hit landed by my gills.
Pain makes my jaws snap wildly.
No retreat in water; only biting.

lines.zh: 我的鳞很硬，可还是破了
lines.en: Hard scales, yet still split.
Even Cretaceous fish feel pain.
I'll remember this wound.

lines.zh: 水里的鱼，我不需要你喂
lines.en: Fish in the water; I don't need feeding.
Toss that meat down here.
The smell of blood drifts through the water.
I'll follow you along the bank.
Throw it closer; my mouth is wide.
That won't fill the gap between my teeth.
Hold it, and I follow.
One splash and I'm there.
When hungry, I'd bite a shadow.
Throw again; I'm not full.
One bump underwater and you swallow water.
Your boot is pressing on my fin.
These scales are hard.
I flick my tail and splash your face.
Don't block my path in the water.
My tail caught your leg.
The bottom's narrow; move.

lines.zh: 我撞开石头，你正好在那
lines.en: I shoved a rock, and you were there.
That was a bump, not a bite.
In water I'm faster than you.
Circling like this is my courtship.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在发亮，是为了你
lines.en: My scales gleam for you.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的河够长，够我们游
lines.en: The Cretaceous river is long enough for us.
Are you a fish? You don't look it.
Let's patrol these waters together.
Fin to fin, tail to tail.
The weeds are quiet; good for a nest.
Swim slowly; I'll follow.

lines.zh: 这河里的鱼，够我们俩吃
lines.en: Fish here could feed us both.
Come closer, don't hide.
Something on the bottom; I've got it.
A piece of meat sinks down.
One gulp of water and it's in.
This one's already dead; I'm not picky.
Whatever falls in the water is mine.
A bit of scrap clings to my scales.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里慢慢咽
lines.en: I hold it in my jaws and swallow slowly.
I can smell scraps on the riverbed.
Jaws close, and it's gone.
Grab it before the fish do.
In the water, you're mine to handle.
The smell of blood gives you away.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，别往岸上跑
lines.en: I've marked you; don't head for shore.
Cretaceous hunters don't waste words.
This bite is for your legs.

lines.zh: 水里没有你能躲的地方
lines.en: There's nowhere to hide in the water.
I'm speeding up; the water roars.
Tired of fish; something bigger.
One more stroke and I'm on you.
My jaws are already open.
I circle around you.

lines.zh: 你在水里扑腾，我最爱听
lines.en: I love the sound of you thrashing.
The ripples tell me where you are.
No hurry; the water is mine.
One tail beat closes the gap.
You'd be safe ashore; too bad.
I'm below, and I see you.
The more you thrash, the easier the bite.
I know the deep parts of this river.

lines.zh: 再往下一点，我就够得着
lines.en: A little lower and I can reach you.
Jaws snap shut and the water bursts.
One bite, and I don't let go.
My tail cracks across your waist.
Cretaceous teeth, densely set.
After this, the water turns red.
This is how fish get eaten.
Step back and I follow.
Don't test my bite.

lines.zh: 嘴巴一张，你就没了一半
lines.en: One snap and half of you is gone.
An ambush from below is easiest.
The surface breaks; I'm here.
Cretaceous river water rises.
My dorsal fin splits the surface first.
A Brazilian fossil starts swimming.
Enough fish here to last me a while.
Jaws open to test the water.
Forty points of flesh sinks to the bottom.
I stir up the riverbed mud.
I'm born into these waters.
Stay off the bank; I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 我从水底的淤泥里摆尾。
lines.en: I sweep my tail up out of the river mud.
The river's master has returned.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我拼命往深处钻
lines.en: The water burns; I dive as deep as I can.

lines.zh: 被抛到空中，砸下来很疼
lines.en: Thrown into the air, the fall hurts.
Even a fish can run out of air.
The blast turns the riverbed upside down.
Something has pierced between my scales.
This pain seeps out from my bones.

lines.zh: 水里没鱼了，我饿得发慌
lines.en: No fish left; hunger gnaws at me.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水打进来，浑身麻
lines.en: Lightning came through the water; I'm numb.
The water is gone; I thrash in empty air.
